Disney reports strong earnings, plans $3 billion in cost savings

The Walt Disney Company announced strong fourth-quarter financial results, exceeding estimates, while its new CEO outlined plans to achieve $3 billion in cost savings. The company's theme parks and streaming services showed significant growth, contributing to the positive earnings report.
